blurb: Guests join fishing charters on the Debra K II, a 2005 Grady White 282 Sailfish boat. Charters range from 4 to 12 hours and target species like tuna, mahi, fluke, and blackfish. The operation is based in New Jersey with seasonal focus on Raritan Bay and New Jersey coastline.
